subject: HelixBank — Executive Immersion Week: schedule windows, travel lanes & AV dry run
messages:
From: Tom Reyes <t.reyes@helixbank.com>
To: grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Nicole Park <nicole.park@helixbank.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Exec immersion week — proposed windows

Hi Grace,

Hope you’re well. We’re planning an Executive Immersion Week at Redwood’s SF site the week of Sep 13 — two full days of executive briefings and a follow-on tech deep-dive day. Leadership availability skews: most execs are east-coast based, two senior folks will join from Singapore, and procurement will need a short commercial sync on travel costs and PO requirements.

Can you:
- Confirm whether Redwood can host Sep 14–16 (flexible on exact 2-day core)
- Propose a sensible AV dry-run window (we’d like a full hybrid test with APAC bridge)
- Share your draft agenda and any compliance/recording constraints we should flag to our legal/compliance team

I’ve attached the current attendee roster for reference (roles + timezones). Also looped procurement: procurement@helixbank.com.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-minute sync if that helps.

Tom Reyes
Head of Platform, HelixBank
Attachments: Helix_Roster.xlsx

From: grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reyes <t.reyes@helixbank.com>
Cc: sean_gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec immersion week — proposed windows

Hi Tom — great to hear this is moving forward. Redwood can accommodate Sep 14–16; proposed plan below.

Proposed core: Sep 15–16 (exec briefings on 15, tech deep-dive on 16).
AV dry-run: Sep 14, 08:00–09:30 PT — full hybrid test (camera, mics, recording, shared slides). If APAC needs an alternate slot, we can run a second dry-run at 20:00 PT the same day.

Internal owners I’ve looped:
- Sean Gallagher — on-site AV & room ops
- Monica Patel — travel logistics and arrival ETAs
- Aditya Rao — venue access & credentialing (badges, guest passes)

Action items for Helix:
- Confirm final attendee list (names + mobile numbers)
- Let us know if recording is restricted or if you need redaction controls

I’m attaching a draft itinerary and our standard AV checklist so we can iterate quickly. Once we lock attendee names we’ll send a calendar hold for the dry-run and the two core days.

Best,
Grace O’Connor
Senior Director, Customer Programs — Redwood Inference
Attachments: AV_checklist.xlsx; Itinerary_draft.pdf

From: sean_gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec immersion week — proposed windows

Thanks Grace — quick ops notes: 
- Boardroom A fits 20 pax with hybrid setup (two ceiling mics + one room camera + 2x Jabra speakerphones).
- Backup room (Room C) configured as overflow; we can mirror via Teams/Zoom if needed.
- Recording: security requires written approval for any recording that includes customer PII; if Helix wants a copy we’ll run through CSM/legal to get a one-off approval.
- Network: will reserve a dedicated VLAN for Helix to avoid bottlenecks during demos.

I’ve attached the boardroom diagram and flagged where we’ll place the streaming encoder. Monica — can you start collecting arrival ETAs so we can plan staff shifts?

Sean
Customer Solutions — Redwood Inference
Attachments: Boardroom_A_diagram.png

From: Nicole Park <nicole.park@helixbank.com>
To: grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reyes <t.reyes@helixbank.com>, procurement@helixbank.com
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec immersion week — proposed windows

Hi Grace — thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming a couple items from Helix side: 
- Final attendee list attached (roles + preferred contact). Two APAC execs will join remotely; they asked for the evening bridge option (20:00 PT) for the dry-run to check latency from Singapore.
- Procurement is asking for an estimate of on-site catering, room charges (if any), and any equipment rental fees. They need a PO template or estimate to start internal approvals.
- Recording: Helix legal prefers that recordings be retained only for 30 days and not stored in third-party cloud persistently. Please advise the retention options available.

We can do a 20-minute sync tomorrow if needed.

Nicole Park
Director, Strategic Programs — HelixBank
Attachments: Final_Attendee_List.csv

From: grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reyes <t.reyes@helixbank.com>, Nicole Park <nicole.park@helixbank.com>
Cc: sean_gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, procurement@helixbank.com
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 14:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec immersion week — proposed windows

All — thanks, this is helpful. Final confirmations / next steps: 
1) Calendar holds: I’ll send holds for Sep 14 (AV dry-run 08:00 PT and 20:00 PT), Sep 15 (exec day 1, 08:30–17:00 PT) and Sep 16 (tech deep-dive, 09:00–16:00 PT). Please accept or propose alternates by EOD Aug 27.
2) Recording retention: Redwood can provide a 30-day retention policy for recorded sessions stored in our secure tenant; we can also provide an export on request and purge after 30 days. I’ll loop Legal if you want the retention addendum.
3) Procurement estimate: Monica will follow up with a line-item estimate (venue ops, AV staffing, catering). Monica — can you target a draft by tomorrow COB so Helix procurement has something to start their PO?
4) Access & credentials: Aditya will prep guest badge process and a staging list for building security.

Links & assets: itinerary + AV checklist in Drive: https://redwood.app/drive/helix-immersion/itinerary-v2
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/HLX-4201
DocuSign (NDA+recording consent): https://docusign.com/00A1B2C3 (will send individually)

Attachments we’ve consolidated: Helix_Itinerary_v2.pdf; AV_checklist.xlsx; Boardroom_A_diagram.png

Grace O’Connor
Senior Director, Customer Programs — Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0198
